detail.longDescription: How can I get the BPM of the currently playing Spotify track in an Electron/Node.js application? I'm building an Electron application using JavaScript and the Spotify Web API. I can already authenticate the user with Authorization Code + PKCE and retrieve the currently playing track using /v1/me/player/currently-playing . I would now like to retrieve or determine the BPM/tempo of that track in order to synchronize a visual animation with the music. I found older solutions using Spotify's /v1/audio-features/{id} endpoint, but it seems that access to Audio Features has changed/restricted for newer Spotify applications. Is there currently a supported way to retrieve the BPM of a Spotify track, or alternatively a reliable approach/API to determine the BPM from the track metadata ( artist , title , Spotify ID) without having access to Spotify's raw audio stream? I'm using Electron + Node.js.
